description: pass along a person's answer to an open ask. an agent cannot close an ask: the answer is recorded and the ask stays open until the person runs the returned person_command in their own terminal.

answer.description: the person's answer in their words

as.description: the member you are working as, e.g. builder; writes are never recorded as a person

ask_id.description: ask id from campaign_show, e.g. a-1b2c3d

cwd.description: workspace folder to run in; defaults to the folder this server started in

name: campaign_answer
